import java.util.*;

public final class Solution {
    public static Object solve(Map<String,Object> data) {
        int n = ((Number) data.get("n")).intValue();
        int k = ((Number) data.get("k")).intValue();
        
        if (n == 1 || k == 1) return 1;
        
        List<Integer> people = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) people.add(i);
        
        while (people.size() > 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < people.size(); i += k - 1) {
                if (i + k - 1 >= people.size()) {
                    people.remove(0);
                } else {
                    people.remove(i + k - 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return people.get(0);
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public final class Solution {
    public static Object solve(Map<String,Object> data) {
        int n = ((Number)data.get("n")).intValue();
        int k = ((Number)data.get("k")).intValue();
        
        if (n == 1) return 1;
        if (k == 1) return n;
        
        List<Integer> people = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            people.add(i);
        }
        
        int index = 0;
        while (people.size() > 1) {
            index = (index + k - 1) % people.size();
            people.remove(index);
        }
        
        return people.get(0);
    }
}
